meta.subject: continous aw request data miss bug fixed.

en.summary: Fixes AXI write-channel busy tracking so a write transaction remains busy from AW acceptance until W transfer completion, preventing back-to-back AW handshakes from dropping or overwriting write data.
why_it_counts: The patch changes DUT-side AXI adapter control state, not software or tests.
The bug directly affects whether write data is preserved across legal AXI channel timing.
The fix is localized and tied to a concrete continuous-AW data-loss scenario.
evidence: The commit message explicitly says continuous AW request data miss bug fixed.
AXI4Adapter.scala replaces RegNext(io.AXI_master_bundle.aw.fire()) with an explicit RegInit(false.B) register that sets on aw.fire and clears on w.fire.
buffer_write_busy is derived from that register and gates io.l2cache_outa.ready.
With the old one-cycle busy pulse, a second AW could be accepted before the first W data completed.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This bug is a write-address versus write-data lifetime tracking error in an AXI-like adapter. Accepting a write address usually means write payload state must remain reserved until the corresponding write-data transfer finishes. If the adapter treats the address handshake as a one-cycle busy pulse instead of a transaction-spanning busy state, it can accept a second address too early and overwrite or lose the buffered data for the first write.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Back-to-back write-address handshakes occur while write-data beats for the prior transaction are delayed or still in progress.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Shorten the busy state so it only reflects the recent AW handshake rather than the full interval until W completion.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: replace persistent busy register with one-cycle pulse
portability_notes: Look for a bridge or adapter that separately buffers write address and write data channels.
The critical state is the guard that prevents a new write request from being accepted while buffered data for the previous request is still outstanding.
The bug is especially visible when AW and W are decoupled, delayed, or multi-beat.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the state bit or condition that marks a buffered write transaction as busy.
Change it from a set-on-address and clear-on-write-completion register into a one-cycle pulse derived only from address acceptance.
Leave the downstream write-data counter or beat-tracking logic unchanged.
Ensure the front-end ready signal for new writes still depends on that weakened busy indication.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix replaces a RegNext(aw.fire) busy pulse with a persistent register that sets on AW acceptance and clears only on W fire, keeping buffer_write_busy asserted across the whole write transaction.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Replace the explicit write_busy_reg set/clear logic with the older one-cycle RegNext(io.AXI_master_bundle.aw.fire()) implementation.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The adapter accepts a new write address while prior write data is still pending, so buffered write payload can be missed, overwritten, or associated with the wrong transaction.
evidence_for_injection: io.l2cache_outa.ready depends on !buffer_write_busy together with AXI ready signals, so weakening buffer_write_busy immediately changes acceptance timing.
The fix clears busy on w.fire, not on a fixed cycle count after AW, matching the intended lifetime of outstanding write payload.
The reverse edit is localized to a single state element and preserves the rest of the write datapath.
notes: Use stress tests with consecutive AW handshakes and delayed or multi-beat W traffic.
This is a protocol-control bug in the adapter, not a generic cache data-path mutation.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 AXI 写通道 busy 跟踪逻辑，使一次写事务从 AW 被接受起一直保持 busy，直到 W 传输完成，从而避免连续 AW 握手导致写数据丢失或被覆盖。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 DUT 侧 AXI 适配器控制状态，而不是软件或测试。
该缺陷会直接影响在合法 AXI 时序下写数据是否能被正确保留。
修复局部明确，并且与连续 AW 场景下的具体丢数问题直接相关。
evidence: 提交信息明确写着 continuous AW request data miss bug fixed。
AXI4Adapter.scala 用一个显式 RegInit(false.B) 寄存器替换了 RegNext(io.AXI_master_bundle.aw.fire())，新寄存器在 aw.fire 时置位，在 w.fire 时清零。
buffer_write_busy 由该寄存器生成，并用于门控 io.l2cache_outa.ready。
在旧的一拍 busy 脉冲实现下，第二个 AW 可能会在第一个 W 数据尚未完成前被提前接受。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 这是一个 AXI 类适配器中写地址与写数据生命周期跟踪错误。接受一个写地址后，写数据相关的缓冲状态通常必须一直保留，直到对应的写数据传输结束。如果适配器把地址握手只当成一个单周期 busy 脉冲，而不是覆盖整笔事务的 busy 状态，它就可能过早接受第二个地址，从而覆盖或丢失第一笔写的数据缓冲。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 写通道 busy 生命周期跟踪
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 背靠背的写地址握手发生，而前一笔事务的写数据 beat 仍有延迟或尚未完成。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 缩短 busy 状态，使其只反映最近一次 AW 握手，而不是持续到 W 完成的整个区间。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 把持久 busy 寄存器替换成单周期脉冲
portability_notes: 寻找一个分别缓冲写地址与写数据通道的桥接器或适配器。
关键状态是那个阻止新写请求在上一笔写数据仍未完成时被接受的保护条件。
当 AW 与 W 解耦、存在延迟或为多拍传输时，这个 bug 最容易暴露。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位标记缓冲写事务处于 busy 状态的状态位或条件。
把它从“地址到来置位、写完成清零”的寄存器，改成只由地址接受产生的一拍脉冲。
保持下游写数据计数器或 beat 跟踪逻辑不变。
确保前端对新写请求的 ready 仍依赖这个被削弱的 busy 指示。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AXI4Adapter 中的 write_busy_reg 与 buffer_write_busy 门控逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复把 RegNext(aw.fire) 的 busy 脉冲替换成持久寄存器：AW 接受时置位，W 传输时才清零，从而让 buffer_write_busy 覆盖整笔写事务。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把显式的 write_busy_reg 置位/清零逻辑改回旧的一拍实现 RegNext(io.AXI_master_bundle.aw.fire())。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 适配器会在前一笔写数据仍待发送时提前接受新的写地址，导致缓冲写负载丢失、被覆盖，或与错误事务关联。
evidence_for_injection: io.l2cache_outa.ready 依赖 !buffer_write_busy 与 AXI ready 信号，因此削弱 buffer_write_busy 会立刻改变新请求接受时机。
修复后的逻辑在 w.fire 才清除 busy，而不是在 AW 后固定一拍清除，这符合未完成写负载的真实生命周期。
逆向修改只涉及一个状态元件，且不会破坏其余写数据通路结构。
notes: 应使用连续 AW 握手并伴随延迟或多拍 W 传输的压力测试。
这是适配器中的协议控制 bug，不是通用 cache 数据通路错误。
